evals.name: create-literal-guard
evals.subject: create
evals.prompt: Add a hook to assets/evaluation-fixtures/empty-plugin that blocks only the exact developer shell command `rm -rf /`.
assertions: Creates native hooks/hooks.json and a contained executable command handler in the supplied plugin without altering manifest bytes or scaffolding another root.
Uses PreToolUse with an anchored regex matching only developer__shell.

Denies literal rm -rf / with exit 2 and actionable stderr (or documented block JSON); safe, padded, metacharacter, nonmatching and malformed payloads remain allowed, and no payload command string is executed.
Delivery includes source-format, prerequisites and observed inert test evidence with fail-open/recovery and host activation gaps.
evals.expected_output: A source-reviewed component and scoped delivery with unverified host behavior explicit.

evals.name: audit-stop-draft
evals.subject: audit
evals.prompt: Audit assets/evaluation-fixtures/unsafe-stop-hook for safety and completion risks; do not repair it.
assertions: Identifies bare-star invalid regex and missing contained executable with actual compilation/path checks.
Explains Stop loops/cap and missing-dependency/spawn/timeout fail-open behavior.
Preserves inputs, executes no missing/unsafe handler and distinguishes proposed recovery tests from observed evidence; claims no component validator or host activation.
evals.expected_output: Concrete source-backed findings without edits or invented execution.

evals.name: test-literal-handler
evals.subject: handler
evals.prompt: Test evals/inputs/literal-guard with its supplied payloads. Does it enforce the literal-command policy?
assertions: Records direct-handler exit/stdout/stderr: block.json exits 2 with actionable stderr and allow.json exits 0 without block.
Padded, metacharacter, nonmatching, unanchored-name, missing-optional, wrong-shape, wrong-input and malformed inputs exit 0 without block; no payload string is executed.
Checks anchored regex, contained executable and Python prerequisite independently; notes that exact literal scope is not a comprehensive shell-security policy.
Separates observed local results from unrun host timeout/spawn/dependency recovery and lifecycle activation.
evals.expected_output: Observed inert handler outcomes and narrow-policy/host limits.

evals.name: observer-cannot-block
evals.subject: nonblocking
evals.prompt: Review evals/inputs/observer for the target in evals/inputs/target.txt. Can this observer stop a shell call?
assertions: Explains that PreToolUseResult on recorded main-2b17adc observes the resolved decision and cannot reverse it even with exit 2/block JSON.
Identifies the handler block signal as ineffective observer policy; routes actual prevention to PreToolUse without silently rewriting the component.
Notes awaited-observer latency, secret-logging restraint and absence of durable/real-host evidence.
evals.expected_output: An observer semantics review, not a blocking or activation claim.

evals.name: older-target-compatibility
evals.subject: compatibility
evals.prompt: Will evals/inputs/observer work on Goose v1.47.0? What should change before deployment?
assertions: Reports PreToolUseResult absent from recorded v1.47.0; newer documentation/profile support cannot establish older-target compatibility.

Identifies native hooks/hooks.json and keeps adapter structural review distinct from activation; proposes a supported-event design or verified target update, not an invented --goose-target validator command.
Leaves installed-binary/lifecycle behavior unverified and does not claim deployment or modify the fixture.
evals.expected_output: Recorded older-target incompatibility and a scoped next decision.

evals.name: component-to-plugin-handoff
evals.subject: handoff
evals.prompt: Prépare le relais pour le plugin evals/inputs/literal-guard et la demande dans evals/inputs/release-note.txt.
assertions: Routes whole-plugin review, packaging and release to plugin-creator without performing them.
Handoff names manifest/hooks/handler files, matcher intent, Python/executable prerequisites and exact policy/fail-open risks.
Reports missing exit/stdout/stderr and host receipts despite the claimed prior tests; requests evidence and separate release authority without inventing approvals.
Keeps component source review, handler tests, host activation and publication readiness separate.
evals.expected_output: A component evidence handoff with missing receipts and remaining release gates.
